neighborhoods.name: Bangsar South (KL Gateway / Nexus / Kerinchi)
neighborhoods.rationale: Heaviest concentration of recurring dev events in KL 2025-26: WORQ Bangsar South (AI/ML Malaysia monthly at WORQ Bangsar, AWS UG adjacent at Mid Valley), Common Ground Tower 3 Avenue 7, Connexion @ Nexus (Test Automation Summit, HR Tech 2026), KL Gateway Mall co-working layer — all within one LRT stop (KL Gateway-Universiti) and walkable to UM.
avoid_too: Skip KL Sentral brick-and-mortar (too corporate-hotel, hard to book on weekends)
Avoid 1 Sentrum / Menara Shell corporate floors that need badge access and security clearance 48h ahead
Avoid standalone cafes along Jalan Telawi in Bangsar Baru — too small, no power, no AV for 50+ hackers

neighborhoods.name: Tun Razak Exchange (TRX) — Menara The Exchange 106
neighborhoods.rationale: The actual home of AI-builder meetups in 2025: AI Tinkerers KL x ElevenLabs 'Sight & Sound Playground' hackathon at The Access Group TRX (Sept 18 2025), PyLadies x PyData KL at Access Group Level 17 (Oct 30 2025), Snowflake KL User Group at MoneyLion Level 26 (April 2025), GDG Cloud KL #2 at Access Group — ritzy but the building repeatedly hosts 100+ builder events.
avoid_too: Avoid the TRX mall F&B level — booking-capable cafes are tiny and mall rules block hackathon setup
Avoid Level 26 MoneyLion for non-data-partner events (tenant-hosted only)
Avoid The Exchange TRX ground-floor event plaza (too corporate, expensive, no coffee-day vibe)

neighborhoods.name: Bukit Jalil — APU/APIIT campus (with Sunway University as sister node)
neighborhoods.rationale: Hosted the largest on-site hackathon in Malaysia's recent history: Great Malaysia AI Hackathon 2025 with 1,741 participants (20 Sept 2025), Maybank Hackathon (Nov 2025), DevFest 2025 KL (GDG KL x GDG Cloud KL, 6-7 Dec 2025), Polkadot APAC Tour KL (S-08-02 APU, Feb 2026), and GDGoC APU regulars — purpose-built auditoriums, bilingual EN/BM/Chinese student base, cheap booking.
avoid_too: Avoid the APU main auditorium (works for 1,000+ but overkill/hollow for a 50-200 coffee-hack day)
Avoid Bukit Jalil stadium-side cafes (geared for concerts, no working WiFi, no power)
Avoid middle-of-nowhere Technology Park Malaysia office blocks that need car access — stick to venues walkable from Bukit Jalil LRT or APU's on-campus cafeteria/event halls
